import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem connected_preimage_expanded_chain {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
  (p : X → Y) (hq : Topology.IsQuotientMap p) {A : ℕ → Set Y} (B : Set Y)
  (hA : ∀ n, IsConnected (A n))
  
  (hB : IsConnected B)
  (hBA : ∀ n, (B ∩ A n).Nonempty)
  (hclosed : IsClosed (B ∪ ⋃ n, A n))
  (hfib : ∀ y : Y, IsConnected (p ⁻¹' ({y} : Set Y))) :
  IsConnected (p ⁻¹' (B ∪ ⋃ n, A n)) := by
  let s : Option ℕ → Set Y := fun i =>
    match i with
    | none => B
    | some n => A n
  
  have hs : ∀ i, IsConnected (s i) := by
    intro i
    cases i with
    | none =>
        exact hB
    | some n =>
        exact hA n
  
  have hrel : ∀ i j : Option ℕ,
      Relation.ReflTransGen (fun i j => (s i ∩ s j).Nonempty) i j := by
    intro i j
    cases i with
    | none =>
        cases j with
        | none =>
            exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
        | some j =>
            have h : (s none ∩ s (some j)).Nonempty := by
              simpa [s] using hBA j
            exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single h
    | some i =>
        cases j with
        | none =>
            have h : (s (some i) ∩ s none).Nonempty := by
              simpa [s, inter_comm] using hBA i
            exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single h
        | some j =>
            have hi : (s (some i) ∩ s none).Nonempty := by
              simpa [s, inter_comm] using hBA i
            have hj : (s none ∩ s (some j)).Nonempty := by
              simpa [s] using hBA j
            exact Relation.ReflTransGen.head
              (a := some i) (b := none) (c := some j)
              hi (Relation.ReflTransGen.single hj)
  
  have hconn : IsConnected (⋃ i : Option ℕ, s i) :=
    IsConnected.iUnion_of_reflTransGen hs hrel
  
  have heq : (⋃ i : Option ℕ, s i) = B ∪ ⋃ n, A n := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · intro hy
      rcases mem_iUnion.1 hy with ⟨i, hi⟩
      cases i with
      | none =>
          exact Or.inl hi
      | some n =>
          exact Or.inr (mem_iUnion.2 ⟨n, hi⟩)
    · intro hy
      rcases hy with hB' | hy'
      · exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨none, hB'⟩
      · rcases mem_iUnion.1 hy' with ⟨n, hn⟩
        exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨some n, hn⟩
  
  have hconn' : IsConnected (B ∪ ⋃ n, A n) := heq ▸ hconn
  
  exact hq.isCoinducing.isConnected_preimage_of_isClosed hfib hclosed hconn'
